AND sl.sale_date >= TO_DATE(#{saleListQuery.startDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD')
AND sl.sale_date <= TO_DATE(#{saleListQuery.endDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD') + 1
AND ( plg.name LIKE '%' || #{saleListQuery.goodsName} || '%' OR plg.code = #{saleListQuery.goodsName} )
AND plg.type_id IN
#{typeId}

SELECT * FROM ( SELECT ROWNUM AS rn, t.* FROM ( SELECT sl.sale_number AS "number", sl.sale_date AS "date", c."name" AS "name", plg.code, plg.name AS goodsName, plg.model, plg.unit AS unitName, plg.price, plg.num, plg.total, gt.name AS typeName FROM t_sale_list sl LEFT JOIN t_customer c ON sl.customer_id = c."id" LEFT JOIN t_sale_list_goods plg ON sl.id = plg.sale_list_id LEFT JOIN t_goods_type gt ON plg.type_id = gt.id
AND sl.sale_date >= TO_DATE(#{saleListQuery.startDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD')
AND sl.sale_date <= TO_DATE(#{saleListQuery.endDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD') + 1
AND ( plg.name LIKE '%' || #{saleListQuery.goodsName} || '%' OR plg.code = #{saleListQuery.goodsName} )
AND plg.type_id IN
#{typeId}
ORDER BY sl.id DESC ) t
WHERE ROWNUM <= #{saleListQuery.endRow} ) WHERE rn > #{saleListQuery.startRow}

SELECT SUM(t3.purchasing_price * t1.num) AS amountCost, SUM(t1.price * t1.num) AS amountSale, TO_CHAR(t2.sale_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS saleDate FROM t_sale_list_goods t1 LEFT JOIN t_sale_list t2 ON t1.sale_list_id = t2.id LEFT JOIN t_goods t3 ON t1.goods_id = t3.id
AND t2.sale_date >= TO_DATE(#{begin, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 'YYYY-MM-DD')
AND t2.sale_date <= TO_DATE(#{end, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 'YYYY-MM-DD') + 1
GROUP BY TO_CHAR(t2.sale_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') ORDER BY saleDate

SELECT SUM(t3.purchasing_price * t1.num) AS amountCost, SUM(t1.price * t1.num) AS amountSale, TO_CHAR(t2.sale_date, 'YYYY-MM') AS saleMonth FROM t_sale_list_goods t1 LEFT JOIN t_sale_list t2 ON t1.sale_list_id = t2.id LEFT JOIN t_goods t3 ON t1.goods_id = t3.id
AND t2.sale_date >= TO_DATE(#{begin, jdbcType=VARCHAR} || '-01', 'YYYY-MM-DD')
AND t2.sale_date <= LAST_DAY(TO_DATE(#{end, jdbcType=VARCHAR} || '-01', 'YYYY-MM-DD'))
GROUP BY TO_CHAR(t2.sale_date, 'YYYY-MM') ORDER BY saleMonth
